preconditions.description: Input dimensions n, m, and K must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= num <= n*m for row in board for num in row)
preconditions.description: Every entry in the board must be between -1 and n*m inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cost <= 100000 for row in costs for cost in row)
preconditions.description: Every entry in the cost matrix must be between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(board) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in board)
preconditions.description: The board must be an n x m matrix.

preconditions.expression: len(costs) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in costs)
preconditions.description: The cost matrix must be an n x m matrix.

postconditions.description: Output must be either -1 (impossible) or a positive integer representing the minimum total cost.

postconditions.expression: any(all(0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < m for i, j in block) for block in valid_blocks) if output != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, there exists at least one connected block of cells (i,j) within the board bounds.

postconditions.expression: any(len(set(board[i][j] for i, j in block if board[i][j] != -1)) >= K for block in valid_blocks) if output != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, there exists at least one connected block containing at least K distinct positive numbers.

postconditions.expression: any(all(board[i][j] != -1 for i, j in block) for block in valid_blocks) if output != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, there exists at least one connected block with no -1 entries.

postconditions.expression: output == min(sum(costs[i][j] for i, j in block) for block in valid_blocks) if output != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If output is not -1, it must be the minimum total cost among all valid connected blocks.
